1: // Simple asteroid dodge game targeting canvas#game
2: // Enhanced graphics: gradient background, star field, asteroid shading, ship outline
3: (() => {
4:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
5:   if (!canvas) return console.error('Canvas with id "game" not found');
6:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
7:   // Sound effects
8:   const crashSound = new Audio('data:audio/wav;base64,UklGRiQAAABXQVZFZm10IBAAAAABAAEAESsAACJWAAACABAAZGF0YQgAAAAA');
9:   const moveSound = new Audio('data:audio/wav;base64,UklGRiQAAABXQVZFZm10IBAAAAABAAEAESsAACJWAAACABAAZGF0YQgAAAAA');
10:   // Ensure sounds can play without user gesture (some browsers require interaction)
11:   const enableAudio = () => { crashSound.play().catch(()=>{}); moveSound.play().catch(()=>{}); window.removeEventListener('click', enableAudio); };
12:   window.addEventListener('click', enableAudio);
13:   const width = canvas.width;
14:   const height = canvas.height;
15: 
16:   // Ship definition (triangle at bottom centre)
17:   const ship = {
18:     x: width / 2,
19:     y: height - 30,
20:     size: 20,
21:     speed: 5,
22:     moveLeft: false,
23:     moveRight: false,
24:     draw() {
25:       // Ship body
26:       ctx.fillStyle = '#0f0';
27:       ctx.beginPath();
28:       ctx.moveTo(this.x, this.y);
29:       ctx.lineTo(this.x - this.size, this.y + this.size * 1.5);
30:       ctx.lineTo(this.x + this.size, this.y + this.size * 1.5);
31:       ctx.closePath();
32:       ctx.fill();
33:       // Outline for depth
34:       ctx.strokeStyle = '#fff';
35:       ctx.lineWidth = 1;
36:       ctx.stroke();
37:     }
38:   };
39: 
40:   const asteroids = [];
41:   // Star field background
42:   const stars = Array.from({length: 100}, () => ({
43:     x: Math.random() * width,
44:     y: Math.random() * height,
45:     radius: Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.5
46:   }));
47:   let spawnTimer = 0;
48:   let lastTime = performance.now();
49:   let score = 0;
50:   let gameOver = false;
51: 
52:   const keyDown = e => {
53:     if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft' || e.key === 'a') {
54:       ship.moveLeft = true;
55:       moveSound.currentTime = 0;
56:       moveSound.play();
57:     }
58:     if (e.key === 'ArrowRight' || e.key === 'd') {
59:       ship.moveRight = true;
60:       moveSound.currentTime = 0;
61:       moveSound.play();
62:     }
63:   };
64:   const keyUp = e => {
65:     if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft' || e.key === 'a') ship.moveLeft = false;
66:     if (e.key === 'ArrowRight' || e.key === 'd') ship.moveRight = false;
67:   };
68:   window.addEventListener('keydown', keyDown);
69:   window.addEventListener('keyup', keyUp);
70: 
71:   function spawnAsteroid() {
72:     const radius = Math.random() * 15 + 5;
73:     const x = Math.random() * (width - radius * 2) + radius;
74:     const speed = 2 + Math.random() * 2 + score * 0.01; // speed increases with score
75:     asteroids.push({ x, y: -radius, radius, speed });
76:   }
77: 
78:   function update(dt) {
79:     // Move ship
80:     if (ship.moveLeft) ship.x -= ship.speed;
81:     if (ship.moveRight) ship.x += ship.speed;
82:     ship.x = Math.max(ship.size, Math.min(width - ship.size, ship.x));
83: 
84:     // Spawn asteroids
85:     spawnTimer += dt;
86:     if (spawnTimer > 1000) { // every second
87:       spawnAsteroid();
88:       spawnTimer = 0;
89:     }
90: 
91:     // Update asteroids
92:     for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
93:       const a = asteroids[i];
94:       a.y += a.speed;
95:       // Remove off‑screen
96:       if (a.y - a.radius > height) asteroids.splice(i, 1);
97:     }
98: 
99:     // Collision detection
100:     for (const a of asteroids) {
101:       const dx = a.x - ship.x;
102:       const dy = a.y - ship.y;
103:       const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
104:       if (dist < a.radius + ship.size) {
105:         gameOver = true;
106:         crashSound.currentTime = 0;
107:         crashSound.play();
108:         break;
109:       }
110:     }
111: 
112:     if (!gameOver) score += dt / 1000; // seconds
113:   }
114: 
115:   function draw() {
116:     // Gradient background
117:     const bg = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, height);
118:     bg.addColorStop(0, '#001');
119:     bg.addColorStop(1, '#000');
120:     ctx.fillStyle = bg;
121:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
122:     // Star field
123:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
124:     for (const s of stars) {
125:       ctx.beginPath();
126:       ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
127:       ctx.fill();
128:     }
129:     // Ship
130:     ship.draw();
131:     // Asteroids with shading
132:     for (const a of asteroids) {
133:       const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(a.x, a.y, a.radius * 0.2, a.x, a.y, a.radius);
134:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#bbb');
135:       grad.addColorStop(1, '#555');
136:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
137:       ctx.beginPath();
138:       ctx.arc(a.x, a.y, a.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
139:       ctx.fill();
140:     }
141:     // Score
142:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
143:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
144:     ctx.fillText('Score: ' + Math.floor(score), 10, 20);
145:     // Game over overlay
146:     if (gameOver) {
147:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
148:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
149:       ctx.fillStyle = '#f00';
150:       ctx.font = '32px sans-serif';
151:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
152:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', width / 2, height / 2);
153:     }
154:   }
155: 
156:   function loop(timestamp) {
157:     const dt = timestamp - lastTime;
158:     lastTime = timestamp;
159:     if (!gameOver) update(dt);
160:     draw();
161:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
162:   }
163: 
164:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
165: })();

(End of file - total 165 lines)
</content>
